IC1: Fasting blood glucose >126 mg/dL at screening. Heterozygous [AND] subjects will be excluded for a fasting blood glucose >140 mg/dL.
IC2: Resting heart rate <45 bpm [OR] or >90 bpm at screening.
IC3: Abnormal thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) [OR] or thyroxine (T4) levels on screening.
IC4: Elevated ALT [OR] or serum creatinine [OR] on screening or any clinically significant abnormalities [AND] on screening laboratory tests as determined by the Investigator.
IC5: History of medically treated [OR] diabetes [OR] or of treated [OR] or medically diagnosed hypertension. Heterozygous [AND] subjects who have diagnosed hypertension and are well controlled [AND] on treatment (Refer to Exclusion Criteria 20 below), are eligible. .
IC6: Presence of a skin lesion [AND] suspicious for malignancy [AND], unless excised prior to Day 1.
IC7: History of malignancy [AND] [NOT] except for treated [AND] cervical carcinoma in situ in the past 5 years.
IC8: Active [OR] or history of any clinically significant medical condition including renal, hepatic, pulmonary, gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, genitourinary, endocrine, immunologic, metabolic [OR], neurologic [OR], psychiatric [OR] or hematological disease [OR], based on Investigator judgment.
IC9: Acute illness or history of illness, which in the opinion of the Investigator, could pose a threat or harm to the subject or obscure interpretation of laboratory test results or interpretation of study data.
IC10: Positive hepatitis B surface antigen [OR], positive hepatitis C antibody [OR] or positive HIV test [OR] at screening or a history of positive testing (e.g. liver biopsy, serology) suggesting acute [OR] or chronic hepatitis.
IC11: Abnormal 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) at screening or pre-dose (Day -1 [OR] or Day 1), except minor deviations deemed to be of no clinical significance by the Investigator.
IC12: Received any experimental [OR] drugs or devices within [OR] 30 days or 5 half lives, whichever is longer, prior to dosing.
IC13: Ongoing participation in a prior clinical study at the time of screening.
IC14: Blood donation within 60 days prior to screening or intent to donate within 60 days after Final Study Visit.
IC15: Hospitalization [OR] for major surgery including but not limited to abdominal [OR], thoracic [OR], or cardiovascular surgery within the past 3 months prior to screening, or for a clinically significant non-surgical illness, based on Investigator judgment, within the past 3 months.
IC16: Planned elective surgery within 30 days of the Final Study Visit.
IC17: Poor venous access [OR] or inability to tolerate venipuncture [AND].
IC18: History of significant drug [OR] hypersensitivity or anaphylaxis.
IC19: History of hypersensitivity to proteins (e.g., allergy shots).
IC20: Use of prescription medications on a regular basis. The last use [OR] of any prescription medication must have been greater than 5 half-lives for the specific medication or at least 14 days prior to admission (Day -1), whichever is longer. Hormonal contraception [AND] is allowed for female subjects.
IC21: Heterozygous cohorts: Use of prescription medications on a regular basis is not allowed with the following exceptions:
IC22: Antihypertensives (<3 medications on a stable dose for ≥ 30 days);
IC23: Statins (dose must be ≤ half the maximum dose; must be on a stable dose ≥3 months);
IC24: Fibrates (must be on stable dose for ≥3 months);
IC25: Niacin (must be on stable dose for ≥3 months);
IC26: Thyroxin (stable dose for ≥ 30 days); The last use of any other prescription medication will need follow the criteria for all other cohorts, as outlined above.
IC27: Use of prescription medications not listed above may be allowed at the discretion of the Investigator upon consultation with Rhythm.
IC28: Use of a non-prescription drug [OR] and herbal substances during the study (through the Final Study Visit). The last dose of any non-prescription drug must have been taken greater than 5 half-lives for that drug before receiving study drug.
IC29: Inability to attend all study visits or to comply with protocol requirements including fasting and restrictions on alcohol, caffeine, nicotine and concomitant medication intake.
IC30: A significant history of drug/solvent abuse [OR] within 5 years of screening or a positive test for drugs of abuse test at screening or on Day -1.
IC31: Positive alcohol [OR] (breath test) or nicotine screen at Screening Visit or Day 1 (positive nicotine screen does not apply to heterozygous cohort).
IC32: History of alcohol abuse (defined as average intake of three or more units of alcohol per day) within 5 years of the Screening Visit.
IC33: History of tobacco [OR] or tobacco product use [AND] [NOT] unless abstinent for at least one year prior to the Screening Visit. This criterion does not apply to heterozygous subjects.
IC34: Previously randomized and dosed in this study. This criterion does not apply to heterozygous subjects.
IC35: Any other reason, which in the opinion of the Investigator would confound proper evaluation of the study.
